name: Balduvian Shaman — fired text change lists only a white enchantment you control without cumulative upkeep
notes: Memory: project_text_change_audit_2026-11-18. The KNOWN_ABILITY_EFFECTS entry carried the '{T}: ' cost, so it matched the card's printed line (a static text change and cumulative upkeep on the card itself) and never the fired ability; once matched as written by _addAbilityPseudo ('That enchantment' read as its target), the restriction is on the effects themselves with youControlRequired. Honor of the Pure is the only valid target: Royal Decree has cumulative upkeep, Glorious Anthem is the opponent's, Bad Moon is black. Nothing changes until a target is picked (the cumulative upkeep used to land on the Shaman); then white becomes black on Honor of the Pure and it gains cumulative upkeep.
